claim.text: The hazard onset was classified as closing, with the struck vehicle already in the ego lane.
Hazard onset was at 6.1333 s and impact was at 8.0 s, an interval of 1.8667 s.
Perception took 0.1914 s, below the 0.3 s threshold.
Command took 1.1879 s, above the 0.1 s threshold.
Brake actuation took 0.14 s, below the 0.25 s threshold.
The brake log was complete, so the timing record is not inconclusive on completeness grounds.
With nominal perception 0.2 s, nominal command 0.05 s, and nominal tau 0.15 s, the counterfactual replay avoided contact and left a 7.898 m minimum gap.
Lighting was daylight, corroborated by an independent witness recheck.
Late command was the primary contributing factor: the 1.1879 s command interval exceeded its 0.1 s threshold, while the nominal-timing replay avoided contact.
